page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re6p.2xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 8 virtual CPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, providing 2 threads per core. It is equipped with 32 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per physical core. The CPU architecture is x86_64, incorporating an L3 cache size of 35 MB, alongside L1d and L2 caches of 32 KB and 1.0 MB respectively. This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations indicate that the ecs.re6p.2xlarge delivers mid-tier performance across most compute and memory operations. In multi-core processing, the instance achieved a stress-ng multi-core score of 7021.12 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 4501.0, both falling within the average tier. Single-core performance is relatively weaker, as evidenced by a stress-ng single-core score of 1317.89 and a single-threaded gzip compression rate of 22.74 GB/sec, placing it in the bottom 25% of tested hardware. However, memory bandwidth remains stable, with read-only large block speeds reaching 50.74 GB/sec and write speeds at 37.46 GB/sec. Database operations and web serving throughput also align with average expectations, recording 2851.3 operations on Passmark and 6.75 GB/sec in static web serving.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.re6p.2xlarge offers a balanced resource density for workloads requiring dedicated CPU allocation without the premium cost of memory-optimized or storage-heavy instances. The lack of local NVMe storage and GPUs represents a clear tradeoff, making it unsuitable for high-performance database clustering, deep learning, or heavy local disk I/O. Instead, the instance is best suited for general-purpose workloads such as moderate web serving, Redis caching, software compilation, and basic text processing, where its balanced vCPU-to-RAM ratio and steady multi-core performance can be fully utilized.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re6p.2xlarge is a general-purpose instance configured with 8 vCPUs and 32 GB of RAM, running on a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor at 2.5 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture and KVM hypervisor, it provides a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio but lacks local storage and GPU accelerators. Performance benchmarks place this instance in the average tier for multi-core processing, memory bandwidth, and database operations, though single-core performance and compression tasks are relatively weak. With a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps, the ecs.re6p.2xlarge offers a cost-effective, balanced hardware profile for workloads that do not require high disk I/O or specialized accelerators. It is best suited for general-purpose applications, including static web serving, Redis caching, software compilation, and moderate multi-threaded processing.
